title: Butterflies arrive just in time to show off during this weekend's festival
text:
Dozens of butterflies were delivered Wednesday by UPS to their new home at Jefferson Farm and Garden where they will be on display this weekend during the annual Butterfly Festival.
The dormant butterflies arrived from Michigan inside a small ice-cooled box where they had been arranged in a series of small envelopes.
